# cost-per-request

> Allocate infrastructure cost buckets to customers by requests, duration or bytes with Decimal largest-remainder rounding, then report cost per request Python package `trysac-cost-per-request`, import name `cost_per_request`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
